name: Artaxerxes
description: Artaxerxes Longimanus, an emperor living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo; and they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
Some of the children of Israel, priests, Levites, singers, porters, and Nethinims went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes, and Ezra came in the fifth month by the good hand of his God.

note.label: Ezra 7: Ezra The Ready Scribe Prepares His Heart

points: Artaxerxes' letter names Ezra a scribe of the law of the God of heaven and grants that any of Israel who willingly desire may go up to Jerusalem with him.

note.label: Ezra 7: Ezra The Ready Scribe Prepares His Heart

points: Artaxerxes decreed to the treasurers beyond the river to supply Ezra speedily with silver, wheat, wine, oil, and salt, so that no wrath would come against the king and his sons.

note.label: Ezra 7: Ezra The Ready Scribe Prepares His Heart

points: In the month Nisan in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, wine is before him and Nehemiah takes up the wine and gives it to the king. This is Artaxerxes the first, the king that came after Ahasuerus of the book of Esther.

note.label: Nehemiah 2: The King Sends Nehemiah to Rebuild

points: From the twentieth year to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes, twelve years as governor in Judah, Nehemiah and his brethren do not eat the bread of the governor.

note.label: Nehemiah 5: Nehemiah Rebukes Usury Among the Brethren
